limitations: Parameters \(n\ge5\) only; no homotopy-type or integral-equivariant splitting claim for the original cut complex; possible unindexed equivalent result; no independent audit.
scientific_integrity: The group and character formulas are proved using an Alexander-dual decomposition, the published shellability criterion, integral duality, and signed equivariant Lefschetz counts. Finite tests are not the parameter-uniform proof.
title: Integral and equivariant homology of three-cut complexes of crown graphs
